Teddy Bear Keychain Style Lip Gloss – Cute & Portable, Multicolor Shades (Pack of 2 / Pack of 3 / Pack of 6)
Bring a playful twist to your beauty collection with the Teddy Bear Keychain Style Lip Gloss. Featuring a creamy, hydrating formula for soft, glossy lips and an adorable keychain design, this lip gloss is perfect for on-the-go touch-ups. Available in packs of 2, 3, or 6, making it ideal for personal use, gifting, or sharing with friends.
Whether clipped to your bag, keys, or backpack, it’s a stylish accessory and a beauty essential in one. With random multicolor shades, every pack brings a fun surprise!

Key Features:

 	Adorable Teddy Bear Design – Doubles as a cute accessory
 	Creamy & Hydrating – Keeps lips smooth and glossy
 	Portable Keychain Style – Perfect for on-the-go use
 	Random Multicolor Shades – A surprise with every gloss
 	Value Packs – Choose from pack of 2, 3, or 6 for more fun and gifting

Available Packs:

 	Pack of 2 – Perfect for daily essentials
 	Pack of 3 – Great for sharing or variety
 	Pack of 6 – Best value for gifting or bulk use

Package Includes:

 	
1 x Teddy Bear Keychain Lip Gloss per piece (random shade)
